correctness.rationale: For the specified W_r, the new reproductive mass is 2xy and its proportions are r and 1−r. Thus s₁=2xy>0 and s_{n+1}=c_{ξ_{n−1}}s_n², where the coefficient uses the preceding switch, not the one at the update to n+1. Expanding a_{n+1}=2a_n+d_{ξ_{n−1}} gives L=a₁/2+Σ_{j≥0}2^{−j−2}d_{ξ_j}. After scaling the discarded tail by 2^n, its weights sum to one, and either constant suffix attains the corresponding extreme. The nonzero affine coefficient follows precisely from c₀≠c₁. Positive masses on every dyadic cylinder give full interval support; a sequence and its possible second dyadic expansion each have zero point mass. Fair cylinders recover the uniform law; disjoint full-measure digit-frequency sets prove singularity for distinct p. For dimension, typical cylinder masses are exp(−k h(p)+o(k)). Uniformizing the eventual upper mass bound on a positive-measure subset of any full-measure set, and restricting the measure there, gives the Frostman bound since an interval of length at most 2^{−k} meets at most two cell interiors. The dimension upper bound uses the eventual typical sets, with at most exp(k(h(p)+ε)) cylinders at level k by the corresponding lower cell-mass bound. The moment checks follow from Σ 2^{−j−1}=1 and Σ 2^{−2j−2}=1/3 before affine rescaling. The proposed F-stochastic control satisfies 2xy≤(x+y)²/2 and its post-image inequality is equality.
residual_risks: There is no dependence on a finite certificate for the pathwise or dimension results. The frozen diagnostics cannot prove those asymptotics. The statement excludes zero initial reproductive coordinates, identical coefficients, and non-iid switching for its distribution claims.

value.rationale: A sharp asymptotic observable distinguishes switching biases that have the very same attractor and interval support of rates; the difference is uniform versus singular continuous law, or mutually singular laws even between two biases. The exact formula and tight finite-time correction supply a benchmark beyond almost-sure extinction. The value is the correspondence for the stated model, not a new fractal-dimension theorem or an ecological extrapolation.
residual_risks: The solvable scalar reduction is special to the stated family, and the result does not give a finite-sample estimator or a general theorem for switched quadratic maps.
